title: Native window: sidebar, unified toolbar, inspector and floating banners
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeData. Press Control-Command-S twice, then click the sidebar button in the toolbar
On the Important tab, click the other split segments; open a conversation and use Done, Remind, Label, Trash, Previous, Next and More in the toolbar, then Back
Press / and type a search; turn Wi-Fi off (or wait for the offline banner) and open the contact panel on a conversation
Choose View > Customize Toolbar, then enter full screen and press / again; repeat once with -NativeFeatures 26
expected: Title is the mailbox, subtitle the account and its size; no empty band above the toolbar. The sidebar toggles with the shortcut and button. Splits are a segmented control (tabs on macOS 27), More past six. Search sits in the toolbar and takes the keys. Banners float without moving the list; the contact panel opens on the right. Full screen and Customize Toolbar work.
